name: jev-feats-without-look-keys
why: Songs measured before pace/bright/texture existed have only energy, mood and tags in the cache. They must still play and style (the dashboard visualizer shows their energy) without re-judging.

name: jev-feats-with-look-keys
why: Songs measured now also carry pace, bright and texture (0..1); extra keys must not upset anything that reads features.
